subtitle: Stone, Water and the Unfinished Dream of Raja Bhoja

panels.shot: high, sweeping wide of a vast rocky gorge with half-broken dams and an unfinished towering shrine
panels.action: Bhoja of Dhara stands on a rocky ledge above the Betwa gorge, cloaked in simple royal robes, gazing over broken stone embankments and the massive unfinished Bhojeshwar temple rising behind him amid scattered blocks and quarries.

dialogue.text: On a wind-carved hill above the Betwa, Raja Bhoja and his masons tried to bind a river, raise a giant linga, and leave a city of water and stone—but Bhojpur still stands unfinished.

i18n.hi: बेतवा के ऊपर हवा-घिसी पहाड़ी पर राजा भोज और उनके राजमिस्त्री नदी रोकना चाहते थे, विराट लिंग गढ़ना चाहते थे, पानी‑पत्थर का नगर बसाना चाहते थे — पर भोजपुर आज भी अधूरा खड़ा है।

panels.shot: slow push-in aerial over the Betwa gorge in dry season
panels.action: The dry Betwa river curls through a rocky gorge, flanked by the remains of massive stone embankments; low light picks out cut faces, sluice gaps, and fallen blocks, with scrub and dust creeping over them.

dialogue.text: Centuries after Raja Bhoja, the Betwa cuts through broken dams at Bhojpur—silent ribs of an old reservoir that once turned this gorge into a high, gleaming lake.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, भोजपुर पर बेतवा टूटे बाँधों को चीरती बहती है — पुराने बाँधों की खामोश पसलियाँ, जिसने कभी इस दर्रे को ऊँची, चमकती झील में बदला था।

panels.shot: ground-level wide along the main dam line, perspective receding
panels.action: A long stone embankment line runs along the ridge, its courses of large, rough-dressed blocks stepping down toward the river; gaps show where sections have been breached, the stones tumbled at odd angles.

dialogue.text: Archaeologists traced three great masonry embankments here, planned to shut two streams and back the water high against these hills—a reservoir stretching nearly two kilometres.

i18n.hi: पुरातत्वविदों ने यहाँ तीन विशाल पत्थर के बाँधों के निशान पाए — योजना थी दो धाराएँ रोककर पानी को इन पहाड़ियों तक चढ़ा देना, करीब दो किलोमीटर लंबा जलाशय खड़ा करना।

panels.shot: cross-sectional cutaway style wide, like an engineering drawing come alive
panels.action: A visualized section shows the imagined full reservoir: a vast sheet of water held by stone embankments, lapping against the hill of Bhojpur, with the temple site perched just above the high-water line.

dialogue.text: When full, that lake would have drowned the valley and lapped at the hill of Bhojpur, feeding canals, turning wheels, and mirroring the shrine on its bank.

i18n.hi: जब भर जाती, वह झील घाटी डुबो देती, उसकी लहरें भोजपुर की पहाड़ी चूमतीं, नहरें भरतीं, पहिए घुमातीं और तट पर बने मंदिर का दर्पण बन जातीं।

panels.shot: medium wide of Bhoja and engineers on the ridge, slightly low-angle
panels.action: Raja Bhoja stands with court engineers atop the ridge line, one pointing with a staff toward the streams below while another kneels with a palm-leaf plan; piles of roughly hewn stone blocks rest nearby, ready for construction.

dialogue.text: Tradition names Raja Bhoja as the mind behind this scheme, a king of Malwa who loved treatises and tools, planning not just poems and courts but tanks and embankments.

i18n.hi: परंपरा कहती है यह बुद्धि राजा भोज की थी — मालवा का वह नरेश जो ग्रंथों और औज़ारों से प्रेम करता था, जो सिर्फ़ कविताएँ और दरबार नहीं, तालाब और बाँध भी रचता था।

panels.shot: tight medium on Bhoja and a senior mason, wind tugging their garments
panels.action: Bhoja, eyes narrowed against the sun, listens as a thick-armed master mason, chalk-stained hands raised, explains the line of the dam, the man gesturing toward the gorge with quiet certainty.

dialogue.speaker: bhoja_of_dhara_and_the_bhojpur_masons
dialogue.text: Stone must obey measure, but water obeys no one. We will teach them both.

i18n.hi: पत्थर तौल मानेगा, पानी किसी को नहीं। दोनों को हमने साधना है।

panels.shot: wide interior-like view of a stone cutting site beside the gorge
panels.action: Workers in simple 11th-century attire lever large stones into place along the dam; others chip and dress the blocks with iron tools, their bodies bent in rhythm, the unfinished embankment rising course by course.

dialogue.text: Hands, not just vision, raised the dams—stonecutters and haulers, engineers and overseers, each course aligned by eye, plumb bob and cord.

i18n.hi: सिर्फ़ सपना नहीं, हाथों ने बाँध उठाए — पत्थर घड़ने वाले, ढोने वाले, इंजीनियर और मुंशी, हर परत नज़र, लट्ठ और डोरी से सीधी की गई।

panels.shot: transition wide pulling back from dam to reveal temple rising above on hill
panels.action: The camera pulls up from the dam to reveal the hilltop with the rising shell of the Bhojeshwar temple: heavy pillars and walls without a roof, cranes of wood framing its soaring doorway against the sky.

dialogue.text: Above this engineered lake, Bhoja’s craftsmen began another undertaking—a temple of Shiva built on a scale to match the waters below.

i18n.hi: इस रची हुई झील के ऊपर भोजा के कारीगरों ने दूसरा काम उठाया — नीचे के जल के बराबर पैमाने पर शिव का एक महादेवालय।

panels.shot: majestic low-angle wide inside the unfinished temple hall
panels.action: Inside the Bhojeshwar temple, massive stone pillars rise, their surfaces only partly carved; in the centre, the huge monolithic linga towers on a lofty square platform, filling the hall with its presence.

dialogue.text: The Bhojeshwar shrine holds a giant linga, carved from one block, towering nearly six metres—a single shaft of stone at the heart of an unfinished hall.

i18n.hi: भोजेश्वर मंदिर में एक विराट लिंग है — एक ही पत्थर से तराशा, लगभग छह मीटर ऊँचा, अधूरे मंडप के हृदय में उठती हुई एकल शिला।

panels.shot: low, close-angle on the monolithic linga and its platform
panels.action: An artisan stands dwarfed beside the linga, examining the precise joins of the rising platform tiers, where massive blocks meet with tight seams and subtle mouldings still being defined.

dialogue.text: Its platform is no casual pile; each stone was measured, set, and interlocked, the whole design recorded in the minds and marks of its builders.

i18n.hi: इस वेदी को यूँ ही नहीं ढेर किया गया; हर पत्थर नापा, जमाया, फँसाया गया, पूरी रचना कारीगरों के दिमाग और उनके निशानों में दर्ज थी।

panels.shot: wide shot of quarry face with carved architectural drawings
panels.action: On a nearby quarry face, lines incised into the rock show elevations, plans and moulding profiles; a few workers stand before them, comparing actual blocks to the engraved outlines.

dialogue.text: On the quarry walls, the masons scratched their thoughts into stone—full temple elevations, moulding profiles, and floor plans, a rare working archive carved where they cut the blocks.

i18n.hi: पत्थर खदान की दीवारों पर राजमिस्त्रियों ने अपने मन पत्थर पर उकेरे — पूरे मंदिर के मुखचित्र, गवाक्ष की प्रोफ़ाइलें, फ़र्श के नक़्शे; यहीं काटे पत्थरों पर बना एक जीवित कार्य‑अभिलेख।

panels.shot: medium close-up on a mason’s hand tracing an incised profile
panels.action: A mason’s rough fingers trace the profile of a cornice drawn on the quarry face, his other hand resting on a matching carved stone set on the ground, tools lying nearby.

dialogue.text: These outlines are not idle doodles; later scholars linked their curves and ratios to rules in the Samarangana Sutradhara, a treatise long ascribed to Bhoja’s court.

i18n.hi: ये रेखाएँ यूँ ही की गई खरबों नहीं; बाद के विद्वानों ने इनके वक्र और अनुपातों को ‘समरांगण सूतधार’ के नियमों से जोड़ा — वह ग्रंथ जो लंबे समय से भोज दरबार से जोड़ा जाता है।

panels.shot: overhead view of several quarry markings with mason marks on blocks below
panels.action: The ground is littered with squared blocks bearing discrete chisel marks and symbols; nearby, the quarry face carries matching signs and numerical-like marks aligned with the drawings.

dialogue.text: On the blocks themselves, mason marks repeat, a quiet code to track pieces, teams, and wages, binding labour, geometry and account into one system.

i18n.hi: इन्हीं पत्थरों पर एक जैसे गुम्फन चिह्न दोहराते हैं — यह चुप कोड है जिससे गाठें, टोली और मज़दूरी गिनी गई, जहाँ मेहनत, ज्यामिति और हिसाब एक ही तंत्र में बँधे।

panels.shot: medium on a wooden ramp leading up to the temple platform
panels.action: A massive wooden ramp with rollers ascends toward the temple’s high plinth; workers strain with ropes around a huge stone, inching it up, while others steady it with poles.

dialogue.text: To raise such mass, they built ramps and rollers, wooden frames and winches, their methods glimpsed in the scars on stones and the sockets cut for vanished beams.

i18n.hi: इतने भारी पिंड उठाने को उन्होंने रैंप बनाए, बेलन रखे, लकड़ी के चौखटे और परखचे खड़े किए — जिनके निशान पत्थरों की चोटों और ग़ायब कड़ियों की धँसी खोखलों में झलकते हैं।

panels.shot: moody interior wide, half-built roofline visible against sky
panels.action: The unfinished temple hall opens to the sky; heavy beams and stone courses stop abruptly, leaving a jagged upper outline through which clouds pass, while scaffolding clings to the sides.

dialogue.text: And yet, for all this precision, Bhojpur’s temple was never completed. The superstructure breaks off, the roofline arrested mid-rise, the carved plans outliving the building itself.

i18n.hi: फिर भी इतनी सूझ‑बूझ के बाद भी भोजपुर का मंदिर पूरा न हो सका; शिखर बीच में टूट जाता है, छत आधी उठकर रुक गई, और उकेरी योजना खुद इमारत से ज़्यादा जी गई।

panels.shot: tight on a weathered Jain inscription slab set into a wall
panels.action: A stone slab bearing a Jain inscription is set into a structure; its script lines are clearly visible though weathered, with the surrounding masonry neatly framed, hinting at the hand that ordered it.

dialogue.text: A Jain inscription from this hill gives Bhojpur its firmest tie to Bhoja’s time, anchoring its works in the mid-eleventh century, even as the temple’s patronage is read from style and tradition.

i18n.hi: यहीं की एक जैन शिलालेख भोजपुर को सबसे पक्के रूप में भोज के युग से बाँधती है, काम को ग्यारहवीं सदी के मध्य में टिकाती है, जबकि मंदिर की सरपरस्ती को शैली और परंपरा से पढ़ा जाता है।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide of reservoir imagined full then breached
panels.action: In a blended image, the reservoir is shown first brimful, reflecting the temple, then the vision fades to reveal a breach in the dam with water once having surged through, leaving coarse blocks displaced.

dialogue.text: Later, under the Malwa sultan Hoshang Shah, a section of this great dam was deliberately broken, the stored waters released in a political act that changed Bhojpur’s landscape and hydraulics.

i18n.hi: बाद में, मालवा के सुल्तान होशंग शाह के समय, इस महान बाँध का एक हिस्सा जानबूझकर तोड़ा गया — जमा जल राजनीति के एक वार में छोड़ा गया, जिसने भोजपुर का भूगोल और जलचक्र बदल डाला।

panels.shot: present-day wide of Bhojeshwar temple amid ASI conservation work
panels.action: Modern ASI conservators in helmets and simple uniforms examine the Bhojeshwar temple; scaffolding and supports brace some stones, while measuring tapes and drawing boards rest nearby, echoing the medieval plans.

dialogue.text: Today, the Archaeological Survey of India studies and stabilizes Bhojpur, reading its joints, ramps, and quarry drawings to reconstruct the methods of its long-vanished engineers.

i18n.hi: आज भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण भोजपुर का अध्ययन और संरक्षण करता है — उसकी जोड़ियाँ, रैंप और खदान की रेखाचित्र पढ़कर उन प्राचीन अभियंताओं की खोई हुई विधियाँ जोड़ता है।

panels.shot: contemplative medium of Bhoja’s statue or imagined figure beside modern visitor
panels.action: An imagined figure of Raja Bhoja, in translucent overlay, stands within the temple beside a modern visitor gazing up at the linga; around them loom the massive unfinished pillars and open sky.

dialogue.text: Bhojpur reminds us that a king’s vision lives not only in finished monuments, but in plans scratched on quarry walls, dams broken and rebuilt, and the many skilled hands that shaped stone and water together.

i18n.hi: भोजपुर याद दिलाता है कि राजा का सपना सिर्फ़ बने हुए स्मारकों में नहीं रहता, बल्कि उन नक़्शों में भी जो खदान की दीवारों पर उकेरे गए, उन बाँधों में जो टूटे और फिर बने, और उन अनगिनत कुशल हाथों में जो पत्थर और पानी को साथ गढ़ गए।

subtitle_i18n.en: Stone, Water and the Unfinished Dream of Raja Bhoja
subtitle_i18n.hi: पत्थर, पानी और राजा भोज का अधूरा सपना
